Amy massages her bruised cheek, crying, “Please, no more, I beg you.” 

On the deserted streets, Amy’s stepdaughter, Jessica, steps forward, screaming, "Stop this! Leave my mom alone!” Jessica’s voice then softens, mumbling, “I will do anything...even being your servant."
